name: io.github.aiwget/aiwget-mcp
title: AIWget Official B2B AI Directory & Benchmark MCP
description: Official AIWget MCP server: search vetted B2B AI tools, run API TCO benchmarks & check DR.

tools.name: inspect_mcp_endpoint
tools.description: Run a live, SSRF-hardened Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC initialize handshake, RFC 9728 OAuth 2.1 metadata discovery probe, and zero-auth tools/list audit against any public HTTPS MCP endpoint.

url.description: Public HTTPS MCP endpoint URL (e.g. "https://mcp.batchdata.com/" or "https://aiwget.com/api/mcp").

tools.name: calculate_api_tco
tools.description: Compute deterministic monthly cost comparisons and hands-on lab caveats (dated Nov 2026) for Enterprise Translation APIs (Azure, AWS, Google, DeepL, MachineTranslation.com) or Real Estate Data APIs & MCPs (BatchData, RentCast, RealEstateAPI, Regrid, ATTOM).

monthlyMillionChars.description: For enterprise_translation: monthly volume in millions of characters (e.g. 10).

needsZeroDataRetention.description: For enterprise_translation: require contractual Zero Data Retention (ZDR).

hasIcuJsonPlaceholders.description: For enterprise_translation: input includes nested ICU plural/select JSON placeholders.

monthlyPropertyLookups.description: For real_estate_data: monthly property lookup / enrichment calls.

monthlySkipTraceMatches.description: For real_estate_data: monthly matched owner skip-trace records.

needsParcelPolygons.description: For real_estate_data: require GIS parcel boundary polygons.

needsMcpServer.description: For real_estate_data: require a live hosted remote MCP server.

tools.name: check_domain_rating
tools.description: Look up cached Ahrefs Domain Rating (DR3 & DR4 when configured), live keyless Tranco Top-1M global rank, and embeddable SVG badge URLs for any domain.

tools.name: search_ai_tools
tools.description: Search curated B2B AI tools, MCP servers, APIs, and SaaS workflows listed on AIWget by keyword and optional category.

tools.name: get_ai_tool_details
tools.description: Retrieve full structured details, verified summary, official website, and FAQ for a specific AI tool listed on AIWget.

tools.name: list_b2b_comparisons
tools.description: List published AIWget hands-on B2B comparison guides covering enterprise translation, real estate data APIs/MCP servers, and AI RFP workflows.
